title: Intent and references
action: Create a brief and like/avoid notes for two local references. Save and reopen.
expected: Notes and asset links survive with the right scope and attribution.
control_or_limit: A brief-only project also works; no provider call or source fetch occurs.

title: One accepted design
action: Edit a supported dial color and marker length through actual UI.
expected: Inspector, 3D and accepted design reflect the same values; unrelated state is unchanged.
control_or_limit: A deliberately divergent projection is detected.

title: Faithful PNG
action: Export a clean watch preview after a visible text/color edit.
expected: PNG comes from the accepted design with required font/asset readiness, not a stale screenshot or independent generator.
control_or_limit: Watch-only export contains no reference panel or private notes.

title: Semantic portable project
action: Export/import into a clean session then edit imported text and markers.
expected: Objects remain semantic; remapped IDs stay consistent; intended dimensions/appearance survive.
control_or_limit: A fixture that flattens or drops an editable property must fail.

title: Supported lock negative control
action: Change dial color unlocked, lock it, attempt same edit plus an unlocked marker change, explicitly unlock and retry.
expected: Unlocked actions succeed; locked batch rejects specifically for the lock, with no partial mutation or history corruption.
control_or_limit: An unsupported operation alone is not accepted as evidence that locks work.

title: History sequence
action: Group a gesture, make edits, undo, redo, undo again and branch. Include explicit lock/unlock history.
expected: Semantic restoration, new current revisions and redo invalidation follow the documented policy.
control_or_limit: Do not let async proposals apply against an old revision after undo.

title: Independent variant
action: Duplicate a design, change the copy, save and reopen both, compare with matched view.
expected: No mutable aliasing; original remains unchanged and comparison uses consistent presentation.
control_or_limit: Immutable shared asset bytes may be reused without sharing mutable design values.

title: Invalid import preserves work
action: Import malformed JSON, unsupported versions and partial projects while a current unsaved edit exists.
expected: No partial replacement or silent reset; useful error and recoverable current design.
control_or_limit: A valid supported import-copy still succeeds.

title: Bounded input
action: Try excessive counts/bytes/depth/decoded image size, duplicate IDs, NaN/infinite or out-of-range values and unsupported asset types.
expected: Reject within declared limits without freezing the app or writing partial data.
control_or_limit: Valid values at the supported limits succeed.

title: No fake trust
action: Import claimed supplier SKU, physical approval, certification and remote asset fields into concept-only M1.
expected: Unsupported trust/realization inputs cannot produce credible catalog/qualification UI or actions.
control_or_limit: A normal concept project remains editable; hashes are not called provenance certification.

title: Share privacy
action: Export the default share design and PNG from a project with unique private strings and images in its reference notes.
expected: No private reference bytes, notes or dangling private asset/trait references escape; export is valid and reimportable.
control_or_limit: Explicit personal backup is a separate opt-in path that can include the supported reference content.

title: Inert references and text
action: Load allowed raster reference; enter markup-like dial/annotation text and a URL-as-attribution.
expected: Content is inert; no script, remote asset fetch or model instruction execution.
control_or_limit: Ordinary text including punctuation works and displays correctly.

title: Save failure recovery
action: Fail document/asset persistence then continue editing and export a backup.
expected: No false saved indicator; previous successful state and current exportable design remain recoverable.
control_or_limit: A subsequent successful save is recognized only after completion.

title: Missing asset and font
action: Open clean session with intended assets, then separately simulate missing font/hash or altered reference.
expected: Normal restore is faithful; missing resources have a clear fallback/blocker and cannot silently bless final fidelity.
control_or_limit: Fallback preview is labeled; explicit replacement becomes a real design decision.

title: Two-tab stale save
action: Load same saved project in two tabs; save a new revision in one, then an old-base edit in the other.
expected: No silent last-writer overwrite; stale writer gets copy/reload/reconcile choice under supported policy.
control_or_limit: Two independent project copies can save normally.

title: Derived artifact dependencies
action: Finish newer render work then delayed older geometry, and separately reuse an unchanged font after a color edit.
expected: Stale geometry cannot overwrite; matching reusable assets are not incorrectly rejected solely due to overall revision changes.
control_or_limit: Input-content and artifact metadata identify what actually produced the displayed result.

title: Units and concept honesty
action: Exercise min/max supported dimensions and render-unit conversion, inspect status/export.
expected: Correct declared units, no invalid parameter coercion, no real-screen-size or physical-fit claim.
control_or_limit: Concept-only numeric dimensions are explicitly design values, not measured supplier data.

title: Complete real user journey
action: Annotate, edit, rotate, lock/attempt/unlock, undo/redo, duplicate, compare, save/reopen, PNG export, import and edit again.
expected: The real primary-browser user loop completes without developer intervention.
control_or_limit: Do not substitute an in-memory round trip or mocked scene for the actual browser journey.

title: Watch quality and access
action: Inspect front/oblique/profile/detail/compare and exported view; use keyboard focus and numeric controls.
expected: Coherent watch silhouette, legible dial hierarchy, no unintended clipping, clear selection/errors and recorded responsiveness.
control_or_limit: Golden screenshots alone do not establish quality; actual visual review required.

title: Runner health
action: Seed failure, missing/zero/all-skipped cases, timeout and malformed report in disposable runner fixtures.
expected: Required machine gate cannot be green; manual pending state cannot be called accepted.
control_or_limit: A valid passing suite with all required cases reports correct counts and exit behavior.

title: Dependency boundary
action: Exercise the actual lint/import rule with a domain-to-render/UI/storage violation in a disposable fixture.
expected: The forbidden dependency fails the real check.
control_or_limit: Allowed domain utilities and normal production build succeed.

title: Evidence and review scope
action: Compare final milestone from its base including earlier commits/uncommitted changes, real command results and inspected artifacts.
expected: No unsupported readiness/independent-review/human-acceptance claim; blocking findings resolved or explicit.
control_or_limit: An old successful run is not used as proof for a changed snapshot.
